name: grooming_wan
default_prompt: the cat moves smoothly from the first pose to the second

1-2.prompt: the cat tilts its head to its left and looks down, its right paw lifts slightly

2-3.prompt: the cat raises its right paw out to the side, elbow bent, and keeps looking down at it

3-4.prompt: the cat brings its raised paw in to its mouth and starts licking it

4-5.prompt: the cat tilts its head to its left while licking its paw, the paw stays at its mouth

5-6.prompt: the cat licks its paw, head tilted further, paw held at its mouth

6-7.prompt: the cat licks its paw, head turning slightly and looking down

7-8.prompt: the cat closes its eyes and presses its paw against its cheek while its head tilts back

8-9.prompt: the cat keeps its eyes closed and sweeps its paw up over its ear and forehead, head tilting upright

9-10.prompt: the cat lowers its paw, opens its eyes wide, and turns its head to face forward

10-11.prompt: the cat lowers its paw to rest beside its body and looks straight ahead

11-12.prompt: the cat turns its head slightly to its left and looks off to the side
